title: Augustana University Doctor of Physical Therapy-Colorado Program Reaches Major Accreditation Milestone
summary_en: Augustana University announced that itsDoctor of Physical Therapy-Colorado (DPT-CO) programhas achieved “Candidate for Accreditation” status from the Commission on Accreditation in Physical Therapy Education (CAPTE).
